adding a product saves its name, prices: Adding a product saves its name, prices and stock-counting details. Record the physical goods separately using New stock receipt.
add a product before receiving goods: Add a product before receiving goods
open setup → products & contacts → produ: Open Setup → Products & contacts → Products. The screen address is /Products.
enter product name, choose category, and: Enter Product name, choose Category, and check Purchase cost per item and Selling price per item. Enter prices before tax.
choose unit of measure and how do you co: Choose Unit of measure and How do you count this stock? Use By quantity (count the items) for counted goods, or By serial number (one number for each item) for individually numbered goods.
if the goods come in different sizes or: If the goods come in different sizes or models, select Available in different sizes or models and enter Size / model name.
under more product details, check item c: Under More product details, check Item code / SKU, GST rate (%) and Warranty months. Enter the appropriate values for the goods. Use zero warranty months when no warranty applies.
select save product. check the product a: Select Save product. Check the product appears under Saved Products; use Search products if needed.
an item code or sku is the shop's code f: An item code or SKU is the shop's code for a product or model. A barcode is a code the scanner reads. A serial number identifies one physical item.
for a shared product barcode, enter scan: For a shared product barcode, enter Scanned / existing code and choose Product / model (same code on every item) under What does this barcode identify? Use Other barcodes for additional shared codes, separated by commas.
the products screen registers shared pro: The Products screen registers shared product codes. Enter individual serial numbers while receiving the goods. Two items of the same model can share a model barcode, but each serial-tracked item needs its own serial number.
add a product while receiving goods: Add a product while receiving goods
in new stock receipt, select add new pro: In New stock receipt, select Add new product.
fill in the product details above. if th: Fill in the product details above. If the scanned code identifies one physical item, choose One item only (unique serial number) and use serial tracking.
Select Save product & add to receipt.
check the new receipt line, quantity, co: Check the new receipt line, quantity, cost and serial numbers. Finish the receipt using Save stock receipt.
if the model already exists, choose that: If the model already exists, choose that model in the receipt and enter the new item's serial number there. Registering another physical item does not require another product record.
zero or greater, up to two decimal place: Zero or greater, up to two decimal places
jpg, png or webp, up to 3 mb: JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 3 MB
check all fields marked * even when thei: Check all fields marked * even when their starting value is zero. If registration reports that the product was saved but adding it failed, follow its retry instruction instead of registering a duplicate product.
Use New stock receipt when goods arrive. A purchase order records goods expected later; it does not add goods to stock by itself.
open receive stock → new stock receipt a: Open Receive Stock → New stock receipt at /Purchases/Create.
choose supplier and check order / purcha: Choose Supplier and check Order / purchase date and Goods received date. Enter the supplier's invoice details if available.
click scan product to receive stock and: Click Scan product to receive stock and scan the shared product barcode. You can also type the code and press Enter, or select Find product.
without a scanner, use find an existing: Without a scanner, use Find an existing item, then choose Product / variant. Use Add another item for another line.
enter expected quantity, received (good): Enter Expected quantity, Received (good), Damaged and Purchase cost for each line. Purchase cost is before tax.
for serial-tracked goods, enter one seri: For serial-tracked goods, enter one serial per good item in Serial numbers: one per received unit and one per damaged item in Damaged unit serials. Scan serial and press Enter adds a good item's serial.
check tax & line discount if the invoice: Check Tax & line discount if the invoice includes tax or a line discount. Review the totals.
select save stock receipt and check the: Select Save stock receipt and check the saved purchase details. Good items become available for sale; damaged items do not become sellable stock.
scanning the same shared product barcode: Scanning the same shared product barcode again adds one more to its line. Check the quantities after scanning. If the product is new, follow Adding products before saving the receipt.
good quantity plus damaged quantity cann: Good quantity plus damaged quantity cannot exceed expected quantity. For example, for ten expected items with one damaged item, enter 10 expected, 9 good, 1 damaged.
quantities on the receiving form are who: Quantities on the receiving form are whole numbers. Expected quantity is 1–10,000; good and damaged quantities are 0–10,000. Each serial must be distinct and no longer than 150 characters. The number of entered serials must match the corresponding good or damaged quantity.
an optional supplier invoice attachment: An optional Supplier invoice attachment accepts one PDF, JPG or PNG up to 5 MB.
open more options: advance order, discou: Open More options: advance order, discounts and notes.
select order goods for later / partial d: Select Order goods for later / partial deliveries and enter the expected goods and quantities.
select save purchase order. stock is not: Select Save purchase order. Stock is not added at this point.
when goods arrive, open that order's pur: When goods arrive, open that order's Purchase details at /Purchases/Details/{id}.
in receive all or part of this order, en: In Receive all or part of this order, enter the actual delivery details and quantities, including serials where needed. Select Save & add to stock.
record each actual delivery against the: Record each actual delivery against the existing order instead of creating the same order again. Users without receipt approval access save purchase orders; an authorized user must record the goods received.
save as draft keeps a purchase for later: Save as draft keeps a purchase for later completion. A completed purchase cannot be edited through Edit draft.
if the save result is uncertain, follow: If the save result is uncertain, follow Common problems and use Retry saved receipt before starting another receipt.
use counter billing to add items, choose: Use Counter billing to add items, choose a customer and record payment. Finishing a sale saves the bill and removes the sold goods from stock.
open sell / billing → counter billing at: Open Sell / Billing → Counter billing at /Sales/Create.
click scan product to sell, then scan th: Click Scan product to sell, then scan the barcode. You can also type the code and press Enter or select Find product.
without scanning, open find an item with: Without scanning, open Find an item without scanning, enter a product name or item code, select Find items, choose Product / size / model, and select Add selected item.
for serial-tracked goods, scan the seria: For serial-tracked goods, scan the serial of the physical item being sold. If the unit picker appears, select the correct Item in stock and use Add item to bill when available.
check items in this bill, including quan: Check Items in this bill, including quantity and Price per item. The price is before tax; each item total includes tax.
under 2. customer, leave bill to as walk: Under 2. Customer, leave Bill to as Walk-in customer, or find a named customer using Find by name or mobile and Find. Select the customer in Bill to.
under 3. payment, check total to pay and: Under 3. Payment, check Total to pay and choose Payment method. For cash, enter Cash received (leave empty for exact amount) when you need to calculate change.
select finish sale & open bill, or finis: Select Finish sale & open bill, or Finish sale if your account cannot open invoices. Check Sale completed before starting another sale.
scanning the same quantity-tracked produ: Scanning the same quantity-tracked product again adds another item. A serial identifies one physical unit; check the unit before completing the bill.
add a customer or sell on credit: Add a customer or sell on credit
use add a new customer, enter name, and: Use Add a new customer, enter Name, and select Save and select customer. Mobile (optional) must contain exactly ten digits if supplied. A named customer is required for credit; check the customer's credit limit before completing the sale.
for several payment methods, open discou: For several payment methods, open Discounts, notes and split payments and select Split this payment. Use Add payment for additional methods. The payment amounts must match the invoice total, and each amount must be positive with up to two decimal places. Credit represents money the named customer still owes.
price reductions may require reason for: Price reductions may require Reason for discount / price change and Request discount approval, depending on the business policy.
select hold this bill after adding items: Select Hold this bill after adding items. Use Saved bills to retrieve it later. Saved bills are available to the same account at the same location for seven days. Holding a bill does not complete a sale; check stock, prices and payment when you resume it.
after completion, use open invoice if av: After completion, use Open invoice if available. To find an earlier sale, open /Sales, search by invoice, customer name or mobile, and select the invoice number to open the invoice. From there, select Sale details to review the sale. In Sale details, View / print invoice opens the invoice when your account permits it.
on the invoice, choose print format: a4: On the invoice, choose Print format: A4 invoice or 80 mm receipt. Select Print invoice. For an 80 mm receipt, use matching paper and 100% scale in the printer settings. Printing opens the browser's print controls; it does not set up the physical printer.
if completion has an uncertain result, u: If completion has an uncertain result, use Retry saved sale rather than creating another bill for the same goods.
record a customer return against the ori: Record a customer return against the original completed sale. Choose the physical condition of the goods separately from how the customer is settled.
open /sales, find the original invoice u: Open /Sales, find the original invoice using Search, select its invoice number, then select Sale details on the invoice.
open return, refund or exchange. this se: Open Return, refund or exchange. This section requires return permission.
Choose Invoice item and enter Quantity. Return only the quantity still eligible on that invoice. A serialized invoice line is returned as one unit.
choose stock condition using the table b: Choose Stock condition using the table below.
choose settlement. for money refunded im: Choose Settlement. For money refunded immediately, select Cash, Card, UPI or Bank payment, then enter Refund paid now. Leave it zero for a settlement that does not pay money immediately.
Enter Reason and select Post return.
review account activity to check the rec: Review Account activity to check the recorded return and remaining balance.
the returned goods can be sold again: The returned goods can be sold again
the goods are damaged and cannot be sold: The goods are damaged and cannot be sold as normal stock
the goods are intended for supplier retu: The goods are intended for supplier return
only resellable goods should go back int: Only Resellable goods should go back into stock available for sale. Settlement records how the customer is settled; it does not replace the stock-condition decision.
choose exchange, post the return, then c: Choose Exchange, post the return, then create a separate replacement sale through Counter billing. Posting the return alone does not create the replacement bill. Check the actual settlement and both records with the shop owner; the original invoice and serial history remain traceable.
the refund cannot exceed the returned va: The refund cannot exceed the returned value or the amount available from payments already received after accounting for earlier returns and refunds. A sale on credit may need Credit adjustment instead of a cash refund. Ask an authorized user to review the invoice balance if the expected amount differs.
this guide covers customer returns. supp: This guide covers customer returns. Supplier returns are handled separately under Supplier account and returns in Purchase details.
check the warranty using the item's seri: Check the warranty using the item's serial number or the customer's invoice number. A claim records the reported problem and its handling; creating a claim does not issue a replacement.
open repairs & warranty → check warranty: Open Repairs & warranty → Check warranty at /Warranty/Lookup.
in search by, select serial number or in: In Search by, select Serial number or Invoice number.
scan or type the number into scan / ente: Scan or type the number into Scan / enter number, then select Search.
open the matching warranty details and c: Open the matching Warranty details and check the item, warranty dates, coverage and claim history.
use the individual serial rather than a: Use the individual serial rather than a barcode shared by every item of a model. Invoice search can find warranties for multiple items on the same bill.
new sales automatically register warrant: New sales automatically register warranty when the sold item's warranty term is greater than zero. A product with Warranty months set to zero does not receive that automatic warranty.
open the correct warranty details at /wa: Open the correct Warranty details at /Warranty/Details/{id}.
if create claim is available, enter prob: If Create claim is available, enter Problem reported and select Create claim.
review the claim under claims. an author: Review the claim under Claims. An authorized user can select Update beside the claim, choose Update status to, fill in How was the problem handled? and Update / resolution notes as required, then select Save claim update.
an existing in-progress claim can preven: An existing in-progress claim can prevent a duplicate claim. Returned, cancelled or replaced items may not be eligible for a new claim; check the displayed status and history.
a physical warranty replacement requires: A physical warranty replacement requires an approved claim and an available serialized unit of the same product. Select Update beside the approved claim and choose Replaced under Update status to when your account permits it. Select Available unit (same product) and explicitly choose Confirmed replacement warranty rule: Continue original dates, New full warranty, or Custom end date. Enter the custom date when that rule is selected.
confirm the provider's coverage rule bef: Confirm the provider's coverage rule before saving the claim update. The original serial stays in history; a replacement is recorded as another unit.
first check the entered serial or invoic: First check the entered serial or invoice and the original sale. If authorized, use Register a missing warranty for an older sold item by entering its Sale item ID and selecting Save warranty. StockFlow uses the original sale date and warranty term; this does not create coverage for an unsold item.
if type or provider is unspecified, ask: If Type or Provider is unspecified, ask the responsible person to confirm it before promising repair or replacement. Authorized users can update Warranty type and provider, provide Reason, and select Save warranty details.
use the message beside the field or at t: Use the message beside the field or at the top of the screen to identify what needs attention. If a save may already have succeeded, check its result before starting a duplicate transaction.
complete the fields marked * and those i: Complete the fields marked * and those identified by validation messages, then submit again.
enter exactly ten digits, with no countr: Enter exactly ten digits, with no country code, spaces or letters. Leave optional mobile fields empty when no number is available.
the scanner does not enter a code: The scanner does not enter a code
click the screen's scan box first. try t: Click the screen's scan box first. Try typing the same code and pressing Enter. Ask the administrator to check the scanner's keyboard input and Enter suffix if typing works but scanning does not.
the product code is not registered: The product code is not registered
in new stock receipt, use add new produc: In New stock receipt, use Add new product if authorized. In billing, find the existing product or ask an authorized person to register and receive it before sale.
check for duplicates, confirm the physic: Check for duplicates, confirm the physical item's serial, and keep it within 150 characters when receiving. Enter one serial for each good or damaged item.
check received (good) plus damaged does: Check Received (good) plus Damaged does not exceed Expected quantity. Use whole numbers.
check that stock is available at the ass: Check that stock is available at the assigned location. For a serialized item, use the available physical unit's serial. Ask the responsible person to review stock rather than changing the quantity to bypass the message.
choose a named customer and check the cr: Choose a named customer and check the credit limit. Collect more payment or ask an authorized user to review the limit.
enter positive amounts with no more than: Enter positive amounts with no more than two decimal places. Their total must match the bill.
check remaining return quantity, prior r: Check remaining return quantity, prior refunds and payments received. Use the appropriate settlement; see Returns.
a screen or button is missing: A screen or button is missing
ask the administrator to check your role: Ask the administrator to check your role and permissions.
the application asks you to sign in agai: The application asks you to sign in again
sign in and check any pending transactio: Sign in and check any pending transaction or saved draft before resubmitting.
a receipt save has an uncertain result: A receipt save has an uncertain result
use retry saved receipt to retry the sav: Use Retry saved receipt to retry the saved request. Use Check purchase history to inspect whether the receipt was recorded. Select I checked history; start a new order only after checking the previous result and deciding to start another order.
a sale save has an uncertain result: A sale save has an uncertain result
use retry saved sale without changing it: Use Retry saved sale without changing its items or payment. Check for the completed invoice before starting another bill. Do not collect payment again merely because the screen did not show confirmation.
for invalid username or password., check: For Invalid username or password., check the username and password, including letter case. For Your account is inactive. Please contact your administrator., contact the administrator to review the account.
forgot password? opens the new-password: Forgot Password? opens the new-password form and carries the username entered on the login page. Account verification is still required to save a new password; contact the StockFlow administrator for recovery.
provide the screen name, exact error mes: Provide the screen name, exact error message, time of the problem and relevant invoice or product code. Share only the details needed to investigate. Never share passwords.

no matching articles. try another word o: No matching articles. Try another word or ask your administrator.
available screens depend on your permiss: Available screens depend on your permissions. Ask your administrator if you need access.
